about: (6c F3 §10.1, KC §5) r04_tree_in_pond_band: a 36x36 claim with a pond at its centre (resolved and reserved first) and a giant oak: the only site that holds the oak's canopy meets the pond's footprint grown by 2, so the oak is refused NO_ROOM and the pond fits untouched (the later part keeps clear; the body is never refused)
